transcript.text: Hi Diane, thanks for calling the Massachusetts RMV. How can I help you today?
I need to book an in-person appointment to renew my license and upgrade to REAL ID.
To book your appointment, I'll need to verify your identity. Could you please provide your full name and date of birth?
Diane Martin, date of birth June 9, 1969.
Thank you, Diane. I’ve verified your identity. To book your appointment, could you please let me know which service center you'd like to visit and your preferred date and time?
Could you please let me know your preferred date and time for the appointment at the Boston Haymarket RMV?

Your appointment is scheduled for October 20, 2026, at 2 PM at the Boston Haymarket RMV. Your confirmation code is 6 9 9 0 4 7. Please remember to bring the required documents for your license renewal and REAL ID upgrade.
